left.pt-BR: Nuna e Lia começam a dançar.
left.en: Nuna and Lia start to dance.
left.es-MX: Nuna y Lia empiezan a bailar.

right.en: The flamingos march and dance together.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Lia march and sway side by side with their heads held high; on the right a group of flamingos marches side by side in a shallow lagoon with heads held high, in the same dancing march. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a far shore band through the middle, a shallow lagoon band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: As duas ficam num pé só.
left.es-MX: Las dos se paran en un pie.

right.pt-BR: A garça dorme num pé só!
right.en: The heron even sleeps on one leg!
right.es-MX: ¡La garza hasta duerme en una pata!

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Lia balance on one foot with their arms out, wobbling a little; on the right a heron stands asleep on one leg in the shallows with its head tucked in, in the same one-leg balance. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a reed band through the middle, a still water band along the bottom.

left.en: Nuna and Lia wiggle and waggle.
left.es-MX: Nuna y Lia menean la cadera.

right.pt-BR: A abelha dança para mostrar as flores.
right.en: The bee dances to point to the flowers.
right.es-MX: La abeja baila para señalar flores.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Lia wiggle their hips from side to side with their hands up; on the right a honeybee waggles in a little figure-eight on the honeycomb, in the same wiggling dance. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a wall band across the top, a honeycomb band through the middle, a floor band along the bottom.

left.es-MX: Las dos se deslizan para atrás.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Lia slide backward in their socks across a smooth floor, arms swinging; on the right a small manakin bird slides backward along a branch in quick little steps, in the same sliding move. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a window band across the top, a rainforest branch band through the middle, a smooth floor band along the bottom.

right.pt-BR: O atobá levanta os pés, um, dois!
right.en: The booby lifts its feet, one, two!
right.es-MX: ¡El piquero alza las patas, una, dos!

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Lia march in place lifting one foot high, then the other; on the right a booby lifts one big webbed foot high and then the other on a rocky shore, in the same high step. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a sea band through the middle, a rocky shore band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Nuna e Lia giram de mãos dadas.
left.en: Nuna and Lia twirl hand in hand.
left.es-MX: Nuna y Lia giran de la mano.

right.pt-BR: Os cavalos-marinhos giram de rabo dado.
right.es-MX: Los caballitos de mar giran enlazados.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Lia twirl around holding hands, leaning back; on the right two seahorses twirl around each other with their tails linked in the sea grass, in the same twirl. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a water surface band across the top, a sea grass band through the middle, a sandy seabed band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Nuna e Lia abrem os braços.
left.en: Nuna and Lia open their arms wide.
left.es-MX: Nuna y Lia abren los brazos.

right.pt-BR: A ave-do-paraíso abre a capa de penas.
right.es-MX: El ave del paraíso abre su capa.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Lia open their arms wide with a big ta-da pose; on the right a bird-of-paradise spreads a round cape of feathers wide on a branch, in the same ta-da pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a rainforest branch band through the middle, a forest floor band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: As duas dançam lado a lado.
left.es-MX: Las dos bailan lado a lado.

right.pt-BR: Os mergulhões dançam correndo na água.
right.en: The grebes dance across the water.
right.es-MX: Los zambullidores bailan sobre el agua.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Lia dash side by side with their arms back and chests out; on the right two grebes run side by side across the surface of a lake, necks up and wings back, in the same dash. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a lakeshore band through the middle, a lake band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Cabeça para cima e para baixo!

right.pt-BR: O lagarto balança a cabeça também.
right.en: The lizard bobs its head to the beat.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Lia bob their heads up and down to the music with their eyes closed; on the right a small lizard on a sunny rock bobs its head up and down, in the same bobbing move. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a garden wall band through the middle, a sunny rock band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: As duas fazem ondas com os braços.
left.en: Both make waves with their arms.
left.es-MX: Las dos hacen olas con los brazos.

right.pt-BR: O polvo dança com oito braços!
right.en: The octopus sways with eight arms!

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Lia wave their arms in soft, wavy lines like water; on the right an octopus drifts in the sea with its eight arms waving in soft curves, in the same wavy dance. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a water surface band across the top, an open water band through the middle, a coral band along the bottom.

left.en: Nuna and Lia dance slow and soft.

right.en: The jellyfish dances slow, slow, slow.
right.es-MX: La medusa baila lento, lento, lento.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Lia sway slowly with their arms floating up above their heads; on the right a jellyfish drifts slowly upward with its bell opening and closing, in the same floating sway. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a deep water band through the middle, a seabed band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Nuna e Lia terminam num abraço.
left.en: Nuna and Lia end with a hug.
left.es-MX: Nuna y Lia terminan con un abrazo.

right.pt-BR: Os grous dançam em par a vida toda.
right.en: Crane couples dance together for life.
right.es-MX: Las grullas bailan en pareja toda la vida.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Lia finish their dance in a big hug, one foot lifted; on the right two cranes dance face to face in a meadow with their wings half open, in the same close embrace. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: an evening sky band across the top, a far hill band through the middle, a meadow band along the bottom.

cover_scene: Nuna and Lia stand side by side in the center, facing forward, with a flamingo, a honeybee, and a seahorse scattered around them, all facing the girls.
